title: Implement pkg/testutils -- DiffTest struct and RunDiffTests (prd001 R1-R5)
description:
deliverable_type: code

required_reading:
  - docs/specs/product-requirements/prd001-testutils.yaml
  - docs/ARCHITECTURE.yaml (pkg/testutils component section and design decision 2)
  - go.mod (module name for import paths)

files:
  - path: pkg/testutils/difftest.go
    action: create
    note: "DiffTest struct, Normalize type, FileExpectation struct, RunDiffTests function, TimestampNormalizer"

requirements:
  - id: R1
    text: "Implement the DiffTest struct per prd001 R1.1-R1.4 with fields: Args []string, Stdin []byte (nil means EOF immediately), Env []string (nil means inherit the test process environment), ExitCode int, Normalize []Normalize, and FileExpectations []FileExpectation."
  - id: R2
    text: "Implement RunDiffTests(t *testing.T, goBinary, refBinary string, tests []DiffTest) per prd001 R2.1-R2.5. Run each DiffTest as a named subtest (t.Run). Execute both binaries with identical Args, Stdin, Env, and a per-test working directory created by t.TempDir(). Capture stdout, stderr, and exit code from each binary independently. Enforce a 10-second default timeout per binary invocation via context.WithTimeout."
  - id: R3
    text: "Implement comparison and divergence reporting per prd001 R3.1-R3.6. Apply each Normalize function in the slice to both binaries stdout and stderr in order, then compare normalized stdout byte-for-byte, normalized stderr byte-for-byte, and exit codes exactly. On any divergence call t.Errorf with: Args, Stdin truncated to 256 bytes, reference stdout, Go stdout, reference stderr, Go stderr, both exit codes."
  - id: R4
    text: "Implement the Normalize function type (func([]byte) []byte) per prd001 R4.1 and R4.3. The Normalize field on DiffTest is a slice. When the slice is nil or empty, no transformation is applied. RunDiffTests applies each function in the slice in sequence, passing the output of one as input to the next."
  - id: R5
    text: "Implement TimestampNormalizer per prd001 R4.2. It must replace strftime-format timestamp patterns matching the ts default format (e.g., 'Feb 19 12:34:56') with the fixed placeholder string 'TIMESTAMP'. Use a compiled regexp that covers month abbreviations, day, and HH:MM:SS."
  - id: R6
    text: "Implement file-state comparison per prd001 R5.1-R5.2. Add FileExpectation struct with fields Path string (relative to working directory) and Content []byte. After both binaries exit, for each FileExpectation in the test case, read the actual file from the Go binary's working directory and compare its content byte-for-byte against Content. Report divergence with expected and actual file bytes in the same style as stdout divergence."

design_decisions:
  - id: D1
    text: "Primary source file is pkg/testutils/difftest.go, not testutils.go. The primary exported type is DiffTest so the file is named difftest.go per the project file naming convention (testutils/testutils.go is explicitly forbidden by the project constitution)."
  - id: D2
    text: "The Normalize field on DiffTest is []Normalize (a slice), not a single function, per prd001 R4.3. RunDiffTests composes the slice by applying each function in sequence to both binaries stdout and stderr independently."
  - id: D3
    text: "Timeout is enforced per prd001 R2.3 via context.WithTimeout with a fixed 10-second default. Each binary runs in its own goroutine; if exec.CommandContext is cancelled by the deadline, the test fails with a message naming the binary and the test case. Do not make the timeout configurable -- the PRD fixes it at 10 seconds."
  - id: D4
    text: "FileExpectation.Path is relative to the working directory of the binary invocation (t.TempDir() per test). RunDiffTests reads the file from the Go binary working directory for comparison. Reference binary working directory is separate; its file output is not checked against FileExpectation."
  - id: D5
    text: "Do not emit any output to the test process stdout or stderr during a passing run per prd001 R2.4. All reporting goes through t.Errorf or t.Fatalf so that go test output is clean on success."

acceptance_criteria:
  - id: AC1
    text: "DiffTest struct has all required fields (Args []string, Stdin []byte, Env []string, ExitCode int, Normalize []Normalize, FileExpectations []FileExpectation) and compiles without error."
  - id: AC2
    text: "RunDiffTests(t, goBinary, refBinary, tests) executes both binaries with identical Args, Stdin, and Env and captures stdout, stderr, and exit code from each independently."
  - id: AC3
    text: "On stdout divergence, the failure message includes the DiffTest Args, the first 256 bytes of Stdin, the reference binary stdout, the Go binary stdout, both stderrs, and both exit codes."
  - id: AC4
    text: "TimestampNormalizer('Feb 19 12:34:56 hello') returns a string where the timestamp prefix is replaced with 'TIMESTAMP', producing output that contains 'TIMESTAMP hello'."
  - id: AC5
    text: "A binary invocation that exceeds 10 seconds causes the subtest to fail with a clear timeout message and does not block the test run indefinitely."
  - id: AC6
    text: "A DiffTest with a FileExpectation whose Content differs from the file the Go binary writes causes RunDiffTests to call t.Errorf with both the expected and actual file contents."
  - id: AC7
    text: "go build ./pkg/testutils/... succeeds with no errors on both darwin/arm64 and linux/amd64."
